items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I remember I told somebody about it when they came by, Martin Williams, I think it was.

ctx.x: You mentioned pedal point ostinados, (PHONETIC) which were something that you got into very early. Let me just ask you, --

Wait a minute, man, I'll say something about that. I remember I told somebody about it when they came by, Martin Williams, I think it was. And no one else is doing it anymore, everybody's playing bebop. He said, 'Well, man, Jelly Roll Morton did that years ago.' So they (inaudible) of doing it until Miles Davis comes along and does it. That's ridiculous, man.
